app.name: ASTU-AMS
app.fullName: Adama Science and Technology University Alumni Management System

home.slide1Title: Connecting ASTU's Excellence to the Global Industry
home.slide1Desc: A unified digital ecosystem that bridges ASTU graduates with global career opportunities, empowers employers with verified talent pools, and equips departments with data-driven insights for accreditation and curriculum alignment.
home.slide2Desc: Connect with top employers, access curated job listings, and leverage AI-powered matching to accelerate your professional journey after graduation.
home.slide3Title: Closing the Loop Between Education and Industry
home.slide3Desc: Tracer study data feeds directly into departmental reviews, helping shape curricula that meet evolving workforce demands while maintaining global accreditation standards.
home.impactDesc: ASTU combines rigorous engineering education with real-world industry collaboration, producing graduates who lead innovation across Ethiopia and beyond.
home.portalDesc: Role-based access for alumni, employers, departments, registrar, and administrators.
home.alumniPoint1: Create and maintain your professional profile.
home.alumniPoint2: Access verified job listings and internship opportunities.
home.alumniPoint3: Complete tracer surveys to guide curriculum development.
home.alumniPoint4: Mentor current students and connect with peers.
home.employerPoint1: Post employment opportunities for ASTU graduates.
home.employerPoint2: Search alumni by expertise, skills, and department.
home.employerPoint3: Provide feedback to enhance curriculum relevance.
home.deptPoint1: Monitor graduate employment outcomes and metrics.
home.deptPoint2: Identify skill gaps through employer analytics.
home.registrarPoint1: Validate alumni credentials against SIS records.
home.registrarPoint3: Send tracer study reminders and audit notifications.
home.adminPoint1: Manage users, roles, and department records.
home.adminPoint2: Monitor system logs, backups, and security protocols.
home.adminPoint3: Oversee institutional analytics and accreditation reports.
home.campusLifeTitle: Campus Life, Facilities, Events, and Galleries
home.campusLifeDesc: A public gateway for the same institutional experiences that shape the ASTU community, from state-of-the-art laboratories to cultural festivals.
home.galleryDesc: Visual highlights from ASTU campus life, events, laboratories, and student innovation showcases.
home.videoGalleryDesc: Livestreams, workshop recordings, graduation moments, and virtual campus tours.
home.accreditationDesc: ASTU-AMS provides verified tracer data, employer feedback loops, and graduated employment metrics to support institutional accreditation and international benchmarking.
home.eventsDesc: Networking, learning, and professional growth opportunities.
home.workshopsDesc: Practical training with RSVP tracking and digital certificate issuance.
home.newsDesc: Stay updated with ASTU announcements and university news.
home.subscribeDesc: Receive announcements, events, workshops, and research opportunities directly in your inbox.
home.successStoriesDesc: Inspiring journeys of ASTU graduates making impact globally.
home.researchDesc: ASTU-AMS connects graduate research publications with industry collaborators and showcases university-led innovation projects.
home.partnersDesc: Institutional partners supporting employability, internships, and collaborative research.
home.testimonial1: ASTU-AMS gave our department the evidence we needed for skill-gap review.
home.testimonial2: The candidate search and feedback tools improved our campus recruitment cycle.
home.testimonial3: I found mentorship, events, and job matches without leaving the alumni portal.
home.faqDesc: Common questions about ASTU-AMS, tracer studies, and alumni services.
home.jobsInternshipsAiMatching: Jobs, internships, AI matching, and candidate shortlisting
home.contactDesc: Connect with the ASTU Alumni Relations Office.
